doc: A transition to a terminate pseudo-state exits its exit set, runs its actions and enters nothing; at the end of that microstep the machine stops without further exit actions and drops queued signals.

steps.doc: The signal s1 emitted on the way is dropped (X -s1-> X2 must not fire); X and P are not exited.
The terminate vertex lies inside P, but P is not entered.
B -both-> C and X -both-> T2 fire in one microstep; C is entered, then the machine stops.
